hero.title: I turn emerging technology into real products.
hero.subtitle: AI engineer & technical founder · CTO at TopBrokers · Founder at Glassear
hero.description: I build agentic AI systems that run in production, not demos. At TopBrokers that means LLM and messaging workflows handling over 1,000 conversations a day; at Glassear, a Studio platform that turns natural language into interactive XR. The decade of hardware underneath is why I know where these problems actually live.
